title: The ARISE Study - Use of Vertical Positioning
official: The Arise Study - Use of Vertical Positioning
summary: The pilot study will randomize 40 ARDS patients who if proning were required would be randomized to upright bed positioning or to stand of care with bed in the head of bed elevation position
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cancer
* Active tracheostomy
